title: Last Flu Season Sent 710,000 People To Hospitals—Most Unvaccinated
hook: The brutal flu toll hit older adults, but vaccination status tells more.
closing: The shot is not perfect, but most hospitalized flu patients had skipped it.
question: Did you get your flu shot?

segments.say: Flu sent roughly 710,000 Americans to hospital beds, making the season brutally severe.
People over seventy-five were hospitalized at nearly five times the overall rate, concentrating the toll among older adults.
About 67.6 percent of hospitalized flu patients were unvaccinated, linking the toll to a preventable risk.
